exposure: pregnancy (in the context of cervical cancer diagnosis)
cohort: The study included 132 pregnant patients diagnosed with cervical cancer from six European centers, matched with 256 non-pregnant controls for age and FIGO stage.
finding: The prognosis for pregnant patients with cervical cancer, specifically progression-free survival, is similar to that of non-pregnant patients.
gest_age: Median gestational age at diagnosis was 18.4 weeks (range 7-39 weeks).
